description: User-generated file and media upload — images, documents, and attachments.

screens_added.name: File Picker
screens_added.purpose: Select files from device, camera, or cloud

screens_added.name: File Library
screens_added.purpose: All uploaded files — browse, preview, delete

flows_added: Tap upload → pick from camera/gallery/files → preview → confirm → upload → success
Drag and drop file onto upload zone → progress bar → file available
View file library → tap file → preview → share or delete
interaction_patterns: Drag and drop on desktop — dotted border animates on hover
Upload progress ring on file thumbnail — fills as upload completes
Camera vs gallery vs files — three options always shown, never assume
File type validation — show error inline before upload attempt
Retry button on failed upload — never silent failure
Preview before confirm — user sees what they're uploading

error_flows.ui: Inline error before upload attempt: 'File too large — maximum [X]MB'. Size of selected file shown. Suggestion: compress or use a different format. Never start upload then fail at 90%.
Inline error: 'File type not supported — please use [accepted formats]'. Show accepted formats as chips. Never show raw MIME type to user. Fail immediately on selection, not on upload.

Progress bar stops. Red state: 'Upload interrupted at [X]%'. Retry button. Option to resume if server supports resumable uploads. Other uploads in queue unaffected. Partial upload cleaned up on server.
Before upload: check quota. If insufficient: 'You have used [X]GB of your [Y]GB limit'. CTA: 'Manage storage' or 'Upgrade plan'. Never start upload that will fail due to quota.
File removed from queue. Message: 'This file could not be uploaded — it may contain harmful content'. Generic message only — never reveal scan details. Other files in batch unaffected.
Warning before upload: 'A file with this name already exists'. Options: 'Replace existing', 'Keep both' (auto-rename), 'Cancel'. Default: Keep both. Never silently overwrite.

edge_cases.case: User uploads same file twice in same session
edge_cases.ui: Detect duplicate by name and size hash. Warn: 'This file has already been uploaded in this session'. Option to proceed or cancel. Never silently upload twice.

edge_cases.case: Batch upload where some succeed and some fail
edge_cases.ui: Show per-file status: green check for success, red X for failure. Summary: '4 of 6 files uploaded successfully'. Retry failed files individually. Never report partial batch as full success.

edge_cases.case: File name contains special characters or very long name
edge_cases.ui: Sanitise file name silently for storage. Display original name to user. Never expose internal sanitised name. Long names truncated in UI with full name in tooltip.

edge_cases.case: Upload initiated but user closes browser or navigates away
edge_cases.ui: Show warning: 'Upload in progress — leaving this page will cancel the upload'. If PWA or native: continue upload in background. Web: warn and let user decide.

edge_cases.case: Camera upload on mobile — very large raw photo
edge_cases.ui: Auto-compress before upload if file exceeds limit. Show: 'Image compressed for upload — original quality preserved on device'. Compression settings configurable in settings.
Detect password-protected PDF. Show: 'This PDF is password protected and cannot be previewed'. Still allow upload if file type is accepted. Note in file library.
